create_get_voting_problem: create a randomly generated electronic voting problem with one-hot encoded votes and a winner label
build_network_definition: build a graph neural network using DeepSets with configurable message passing steps
train_election_model: train a graph neural network to predict the winner of an electronic election
run_election_prediction: run an electronic voting example that estimates the election winner using a GNN
test_voting_accuracy: test the GNN voting model accuracy on train and test datasets over multiple steps
